summary:
THOUGHT GAINED: IN UNFAMILIAR SKIN
Problem: There is a sizeable list of things that have happened to you following your first 14 hours awake and alive as less of a drunk force of nature, and more of a human person. While much of this list can be naturally attributed to your complete and utter lack of memory, part of it you can't help but feel is something new that has settled in while you weren't looking. Something that has made you lose your reflection, and pulse altogether. It's an array of new thoughts and senses that have taken root in the base of your skull, making you hesitate to enter a building without permission, or detect when someone is there before you have even seen them. It's just under your skin, but you don't know what it could be.
BONUSES: +2 Inland Empire - Tuning in to what you are.
TIME TO INTERNALIZE: 72 HOURS
INLAND EMPIRE (Easy: Success) - Hmm. This ones a doozy. That's okay- you'll take to it soon. Like a natural fight-or-flight reflex, or newly ingrained instincts. We'll figure it out.
